title: Longest Arithmetic Subsequence
goal: Track equally spaced runs taken in index order and report the longest run.
strategy: For each end index, keep the best run length for every difference seen so far.

phasePurposes.update: Record the extended run under that gap.

edgeCases: Repeated equal values use difference zero
A descending arithmetic chain uses a negative difference
Two values always form an arithmetic subsequence
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.

verification.reason: User requested implementation without tests or builds.
